snippet.title: Rest Stop - Official Release Date Announcement Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description:
Don't miss the Release Date Announcement Trailer for Rest Stop, a psychological horror game developed by Ant Parade Interactive. Players will traverse an abandoned highway rest stop to locate a missing friend. Solve light puzzles and feel dread in Rest Stop, launching on December 28 for PC (Steam).

#ign #gaming
